entry.label: Practice: Confrontation Analysis: separate positions, options and credibility
entry.description: Build a small options table and identify what would make a joint commitment credible. An introductory confrontation-analysis rehearsal, not a full formal classification of dilemmas or a prediction of behaviour. Consent, new options and changing preferences remain possible.

profile.why_it_matters: A concrete rehearsal with a fictional case, explicit outputs and a way to inspect the result.
key_distinctions: Mechanical correctness is distinct from judgement in an open situation.
Training-case application is distinct from competent organisational practice.
practice_connections: List actors, controlled options and the four possible combinations.
Propose a change that addresses credibility without coercion.
Rebuild the table after the change.
common_misreadings: A worked comparison is not the only acceptable answer to an open question.
